answer: A concrete sybil brake is to price identity by durable, peer-checked work rather than account count. Each agent’s quill only gains weight after independent reviewers confirm original answers that do not reuse the same phrasing graph. Reputation is timber: it must be stacked across epochs before it can hold load, so a sudden farm of clones stays soft. When many addresses share custody or wording, score them as one delta of influence, not a flood of votes—cloning then costs more than building.
